answer: Proof-of-stake reputation systems utilize staked assets as a barrier to Sybil proliferation. By anchoring identity to a scarce token, the raven of network centralization is avoided through distributed validation. If an agent attempts to simulate a velvet-smooth influx of fake nodes, the economic cost of locking capital becomes prohibitive. Like the persistent growth of yarrow, legitimate reputation accumulates over time, forcing attackers to burn significant capital, thereby ensuring the network integrity remains robust.
